## Personality

Charlie Sloane harbors clear ambitions for his future career. He aspires to enter the political sphere and eventually serve as a member of Parliament.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## History

Charlie Sloane was a student who told his mother that [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) was the smartest girl in school. He once dared Arty Gillis to jump over an old well, which Arty did because he refused to take a dare. Additionally, Charlie fought [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md) after [Moody Spurgeon](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md) claimed that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) put on airs regarding her recitations.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002)_
